verdict.rationale: Fireworks markets running "the latest open models with a single line of code" and "instant access to the most popular OSS models", and its catalog spans 100+ models. These claims point toward fast catalog updates, but nothing documents how quickly new releases actually arrive. The Hugging Face custom-upload path is a separate self-serve capability and is not credited here as platform-provided day-zero availability. missing for 10: documented time-to-availability or day-0 launch commitments for new open-weight releases, concrete examples of models added at release, independent or hands-on corroboration of release speed.
